item.chronicles_of_lost_arcana.angel_sta: Right-click to cast the selected spell; Alt+Scroll to switch.
Shift+right-click to open infusion (costs Arcane Crystal Shards).
spell.chronicles_of_lost_arcana.wing_fli: Fly freely for 60s: hold jump to ascend, release to glide down. Slow fall if it expires mid-air. Cooldown 3m; 35 mana; 25 Arcane Crystal Shards to infuse.
spell.chronicles_of_lost_arcana.feather_: Wing of the Fifth Rank: Feather Ward
Grants yourself Absorption III (4 extra hearts) for 15s. Cooldown 90s; 12 mana; 10 Arcane Crystal Shards to infuse.
spell.chronicles_of_lost_arcana.sky_feat: Wing of the Fourth Rank: Sky Feather Rain
Lock-on: rains 7 homing feathers, each hit dealing 1.5 damage (blocked by terrain). Cooldown 35s; 16 mana; 7 Arcane Crystal Shards to infuse.
spell.chronicles_of_lost_arcana.beloved_: Wing of the Sixth Rank: My Wing's Beloved
Lock-on: grants the player you are looking at Absorption II for 8s. Cooldown 60s; 10 mana; 4 Arcane Crystal Shards to infuse.
spell.chronicles_of_lost_arcana.claw_ren: Claw of the Fifth Rank: Rend
Deals 4.5 damage and knocks back targets within 4.5 blocks in a 90° arc, with a claw swipe effect. Cooldown 23s; 11 mana; 8 Arcane Crystal Shards to infuse.
message.chronicles_of_lost_arcana.infusi: Infusion slots full; replace a spell (no refund).
screen.chronicles_of_lost_arcana.replace: When 8 slots are full, click a slot to pick a replace target, then click a spell on the right (no refund).
Slot %s picked; click a spell on the right to replace (no refund).
